headline.intro: Six Claude Code sessions, five worktrees and 21 branches in this repo, read back into one picture: what each one was asked to do, what it decided, how far it got, and whether any of it reached main.

actions.title: Push main to origin
actions.why: 58 commits sit only on this Mac — the Vouched Scribe, the poster tier, the ground law, every merge since 08-08. One disk failure loses ten days.

actions.title: Throw away the vendored-asset edits
actions.why: katex.min.css/js and mermaid.min.js are reformatted third-party bundles — the docgarden formatter hook ran over them. Content differs from HEAD even ignoring whitespace, so this is damage, not noise. Never commit it.

actions.title: Ignore the 486 MB log archive
actions.why: system_logs.logarchive (486 MB) and shots-ios (8.6 MB) are untracked and unignored — one `git add -A` puts them in history permanently.

actions.title: Commit the real config, on purpose
actions.why: .githooks/, .github/, .docgarden.toml and .docgarden/ are small, intentional, and belong in the repo. Add them by name — never with -A.

actions.title: Retire three finished worktrees
actions.why: grove-suggest, grove-sync-on-the-mac and conductor/accra all sit on branches fully merged into main. Their only uncommitted content is regenerated artefacts.
actions.cmd: git worktree remove ../grove-suggest && git worktree remove ../grove-sync-on-the-mac

actions.title: Close six idle terminal sessions
actions.why: Six Claude sessions in the root checkout have been open 2–7 days with no activity since 08-18 14:57. They share one working tree, which is how a formatter hook reaches files nobody is editing.

actions.title: Land or park the honesty layer
actions.why: The only branch holding unmerged work. Its loop has run 1d 16h against a bar it has not yet been shown to clear.

decisions.text: A visual change is not done until it has been looked at. Written into CLAUDE.md at HEAD, after the ghost overlap and floating bullets both merged behind a green suite on the same day.
The ghost stands only on empty ground, and waits for writing — suggest never overlays existing text and never fires on review.
The bar for suggest is Cursor's Tab, used live on this Mac, not described. Every builder and critic reads one dossier.
Posters are generated from a closed element vocabulary with a blunt SVG sanitizer — the renderer never trusts a provider.
Quiet syntax: markers never render, rhythm is em-based, the caret goes transparent. Reveal is gone by design.
Open, undecided: does the honesty layer clear NotebookLM blind? Everything else on this canvas is settled.
